Select IC50 activity rows for human Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Join docs via activities.doc_id to require PubMed ID or DOI. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
